_comment: Parameters for push-triggered loadtest-live runs. workflow_dispatch inputs override these when the workflow is started manually from the Actions tab.
_notes: auth_pace_rps keeps authenticated scenarios inside the workspace rate limit:
config.freeRateLimit is 10 requests per 60s window (PRO 60, grandfathered FREE 30),
and the dashboard path keys its bucket on workspace+IP. Unpaced authenticated
requests measure the 429 path, not the verification path.
For the aggressive saturation ramp switch to: profile=load with the stages above.
